title: 國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程
titleEn: Submarine Context and Underwater Vehicle Engineering
summary: 從國造潛艦的公開科普入口轉向民用水下載具的浮力、配重與科學量測；比較常壓浮體模型與實際壓力邊界，練習辨識不能從桌面算例推論的事項。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use a public submarine-education entry to study civil underwater-vehicle buoyancy, trim and scientific measurements. Compare an unpressurized float model with a real pressure boundary and identify claims that a desktop calculation cannot support. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 浮力等於排開流體的重量，完全浸沒時體積變化與密度變化都重要。
knowledge.textEn: Buoyancy equals displaced-fluid weight; volume and density changes matter when fully submerged.
